senses.gloss:
a
(the first letter of the Sanskrit alphabet)
------------------------------------------
Being the first manifest sound that emerged out of the डमरु (miniature drum) of Lord शिव during his famous dance (tāṇḍavanṛtya), it is the first letter of the Sanskrit alphabet and the fundamental sound without which no other letter can be pronounced. Hence it is identified with God himself or used as his symbol. The Sanskrit lexicons give as many as 31 meanings and it is used in six different ways in grammar.
